subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Meltwater - decision: report as-is, guarded rollout ask
body:
Decision: option (a). The M3 report ships Friday with the 11.4% offline miss-rate reduction as the headline and the index-rebuild windows called out as a known weakness, quantified per shard. We stay inside the window and keep credibility.

Go/no-go outcome I'm proposing to the review: GO for a serving experiment in Q3, but guarded - the experiment config falls back to production LRU during rebuild windows until Quentin's rebuild-aware training lands. Zeke, that fallback switch is the one thing I need your team to commit to before I take this to the review; can you confirm feasibility by Wednesday?

Q3 planning note (OKRs lock Jun 26): Meltwater's committed item is the serving experiment with a miss-rate target; rebuild-aware training is the stretch. Ivo, keep Quentin at 60% in your Q3 sheet.

Good work all - a real dollars-and-cents result.

Anders
